parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The business space key. If you do not specify this parameter, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: ApplyType
parameters.description:
The append type. Valid values:
- memberName: a member of a proper noun
- synonyms: a similar question for a proper noun.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: The member and synonyms (similar questions) of a standard noun.
